table_description: Date dimension table containing one row per calendar day. Covers the full TPC-DS date range (~73,000 rows spanning ~200 years, of which ~5 years contain sales data). This is the most frequently joined dimension — every sales fact table has a date SK column. Provides rich time attributes for slicing by year, quarter, month, week, day-of-week, holiday, and fiscal periods.
use_cases: Filtering sales by year, quarter, or month
data_quality_notes: D_DATE_SK is the integer surrogate key used in all fact table joins (SS_SOLD_DATE_SK, CS_SOLD_DATE_SK, WS_SOLD_DATE_SK, etc.).
D_DATE is the actual calendar date as a string 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
D_YEAR contains the 4-digit calendar year — use this for year filtering instead of extracting from D_DATE.
D_HOLIDAY is 'Y' or 'N' — not a boolean.
D_WEEKEND is 'Y' or 'N' — not a boolean.
D_CURRENT_YEAR is 'Y' or 'N' — marks the current year in the dataset.
D_SAME_DAY_LY and D_SAME_DAY_LQ are SKs pointing to the equivalent day last year/last quarter — use for same-period comparisons without complex date math.
TPC-DS sales data covers years 1998-2002 approximately — filter on D_YEAR between 1998 and 2002 for valid data.
